ucs.title: [LLM] Volt Typhoon internal pivot via netsh portproxy (KV Botnet → enterprise relay)
ucs.description: Hunts the netsh interface portproxy command Volt Typhoon (Vanguard Panda / VOLTZITE) uses to turn a compromised edge host into a TCP relay from their ORB / KV Botnet infrastructure into the enterprise — a hallmark CISA-documented LOTL technique on US critical-infrastructure intrusions.
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=true count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where Processes.process_name=netsh.exe Processes.process="*interface*" Processes.process="*portproxy*" Processes.process="*add*" (Processes.process="*v4tov4*" OR Processes.process="*v4tov6*" OR Processes.process="*v6tov4*" OR Processes.process="*v6tov6*") NOT Processes.user="*$" by Processes.dest Processes.user Processes.parent_process_name Processes.parent_process Processes.process_name Processes.process | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` | rex field=process "(?i)listenport=(?<listen_port>\d+).*?connectaddress=(?<connect_ip>[\d\.]+).*?connectport=(?<connect_port>\d+)" | convert ctime(firstTime) ctime(lastTime) | sort - lastTime
ucs.kql:
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(30d)
| where FileName =~ "netsh.exe"
| where ProcessCommandLine has "portproxy"
| where ProcessCommandLine has "add"
| where ProcessCommandLine has_any ("v4tov4","v4tov6","v6tov4","v6tov6")
| where AccountName !endswith "$"
| where InitiatingProcessAccountName !in~ ("system","local service","network service")
| extend ListenPort  = extract(@'(?i)listenport=(\d+)',     1, ProcessCommandLine),
         ConnectIP   = extract(@'(?i)connectaddress=([\d\.]+)', 1, ProcessCommandLine),
         ConnectPort = extract(@'(?i)connectport=(\d+)',    1, ProcessCommandLine)
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName,
          ParentImage = InitiatingProcessFileName,
          ParentCmd   = InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
          ProcessCommandLine,
          ListenPort, ConnectIP, ConnectPort
| order by Timestamp desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
SecurityEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(30d)
| where EventID == 4688
| where NewProcessName endswith "\\netsh.exe"
| where CommandLine has "portproxy"
| where CommandLine has "add"
| where CommandLine has_any ("v4tov4","v4tov6","v6tov4","v6tov6")
| where SubjectUserName !endswith "$"
| where SubjectUserName !in~ ("system","local service","network service")
| extend ListenPort  = extract(@'(?i)listenport=(\d+)',     1, CommandLine),
         ConnectIP   = extract(@'(?i)connectaddress=([\d\.]+)', 1, CommandLine),
         ConnectPort = extract(@'(?i)connectport=(\d+)',    1, CommandLine)
| project TimeGenerated, Computer, SubjectUserName, ParentProcessName, NewProcessName, CommandLine, ListenPort, ConnectIP, ConnectPort
| order by TimeGenerated desc
ucs.sigma_yaml:
title: Volt Typhoon netsh portproxy internal pivot
id: 0c4d4cf2-3a3e-4d7b-b9d4-e5c1f1b9d111
status: experimental
description: netsh interface portproxy add — used by Volt Typhoon to relay traffic from compromised edge / SOHO routers into internal networks.
references:
  - https://www.cisa.gov/news-events/cybersecurity-advisories/aa24-038a
author: SOC Detection Engineering
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection_image:
    Image|endswith: '\netsh.exe'
  selection_args:
    CommandLine|contains|all:
      - 'portproxy'
      - 'add'
  selection_proto:
    CommandLine|contains:
      - 'v4tov4'
      - 'v4tov6'
      - 'v6tov4'
      - 'v6tov6'
  filter_machine_acct:
    User|endswith: '$'
  condition: (selection_image and selection_args and selection_proto) and not filter_machine_acct
falsepositives:
  - Rare legitimate use by network admins (document and allowlist by host/user)
level: high
tags:
  - attack.command_and_control
  - attack.t1090.001
  - attack.t1059.003
ucs.datadog_query: (source:windows.sysmon @EventID:1 OR source:windows.security @EventID:4688) @Image:(*\\netsh.exe OR *\\NETSH.EXE OR *\\Netsh.exe) @CommandLine:(*portproxy* AND *add* AND (*v4tov4* OR *v4tov6* OR *v6tov4* OR *v6tov6*)) -@User:*$
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2 ImageFileName=/\\netsh\.exe$/i
| regex("portproxy", field=CommandLine, flags="i")
| regex("\\sadd\\s", field=CommandLine, flags="i")
| regex("(v4tov4|v4tov6|v6tov4|v6tov6)", field=CommandLine, flags="i")
| NOT UserName=/\$$/
| ListenPort  := regex("(?i)listenport=(?<lp>\\d+)", field=CommandLine, strict=false) | ConnectIP := regex("(?i)connectaddress=(?<cip>[\\d\\.]+)", field=CommandLine, strict=false) | ConnectPort := regex("(?i)connectport=(?<cp>\\d+)", field=CommandLine, strict=false)
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, UserName, ParentBaseFileName, CommandLine], function=count())

The legit use of netsh portproxy in production environments is extremely rare (most port-forwarding is done via routing/firewall gear) — pairing the binary with the portproxy + add + protocol-pair tokens, and ex

ucs.title: [LLM] Volt Typhoon NTDS.dit theft via ntdsutil IFM staged to C:\Windows\Temp
ucs.description: Hunts the exact ntdsutil 'activate instance ntds → IFM → create full' chain Volt Typhoon uses to dump the Active Directory database from compromised domain controllers, with the output frequently staged to C:\Windows\Temp\Pro or C:\Users\Public before archival and exfil — a fingerprinted CISA-documented Volt Typhoon credential-access primitive.
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=true count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where (Processes.process_name=ntdsutil.exe OR Processes.process="*ntdsutil*") (Processes.process="*ifm*" OR Processes.process="*ac i ntds*" OR Processes.process="*activate instance ntds*") Processes.process="*create full*" by Processes.dest Processes.user Processes.parent_process_name Processes.parent_process Processes.process_name Processes.process | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` | rex field=process "(?i)create\s+full\s+(?<staging_path>\S+)" | search staging_path="C:\\*" | convert ctime(firstTime) ctime(lastTime) | sort - lastTime
ucs.kql:
let NtdsutilExec =
    DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(30d)
    | where FileName =~ "ntdsutil.exe"
       or (FileName =~ "cmd.exe" and ProcessCommandLine has "ntdsutil")
       or (InitiatingProcessFileName =~ "cmd.exe" and InitiatingProcessCommandLine has "ntdsutil")
    | where ProcessCommandLine has "create full"
         or ProcessCommandLine has "ifm"
         or ProcessCommandLine has "ac i ntds"
         or ProcessCommandLine has "activate instance ntds"
    | extend StagingPath = extract(@'(?i)create\s+full\s+(\S+)', 1, ProcessCommandLine)
    | project Timestamp, DeviceId, DeviceName, AccountName,
              ParentImage = InitiatingProcessFileName,
              ParentCmd   = InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
              FileName, ProcessCommandLine, StagingPath;
NtdsutilExec
| join kind=leftouter (
    DeviceFileEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(30d)
    | where ActionType in ("FileCreated","FileRenamed","FileModified")
    | where FileName in~ ("ntds.dit","SYSTEM","SECURITY","SAM")
         or FolderPath has_any (@"\Windows\Temp\", @"\Users\Public\", @"\PerfLogs\")
    | project Timestamp, DeviceId, FilePath = strcat(FolderPath, FileName), FileWriter = InitiatingProcessFileName
) on DeviceId
| where isnotempty(StagingPath) or isnotempty(FilePath)
| order by Timestamp desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
let NtdsutilExec =
    SecurityEvent
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(30d)
    | where EventID == 4688
    | where (NewProcessName endswith "\\ntdsutil.exe")
         or (NewProcessName endswith "\\cmd.exe" and CommandLine has "ntdsutil")
         or (ParentProcessName endswith "\\cmd.exe" and CommandLine has "ntdsutil")
    | where CommandLine has "create full"
         or CommandLine has "ifm"
         or CommandLine has "ac i ntds"
         or CommandLine has "activate instance ntds"
    | extend StagingPath = extract(@'(?i)create\s+full\s+(\S+)', 1, CommandLine)
    | project TimeGenerated, Computer, SubjectUserName, ParentProcessName, NewProcessName, CommandLine, StagingPath;
NtdsutilExec
| order by TimeGenerated desc
ucs.sigma_yaml:
title: Volt Typhoon NTDS.dit theft via ntdsutil IFM
id: 5d1f8e92-7f6a-44e2-9c2b-3d4a6f5b1212
status: experimental
description: ntdsutil 'create full' / IFM chain used by Volt Typhoon to export the Active Directory database (ntds.dit) from compromised domain controllers.
references:
  - https://www.cisa.gov/news-events/cybersecurity-advisories/aa23-144a
  - https://www.cisa.gov/news-events/cybersecurity-advisories/aa24-038a
author: SOC Detection Engineering
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection_image:
    Image|endswith: '\ntdsutil.exe'
  selection_via_cmd:
    CommandLine|contains: 'ntdsutil'
  selection_args:
    CommandLine|contains: 'create full'
  selection_ifm:
    CommandLine|contains:
      - 'ifm'
      - 'ac i ntds'
      - 'activate instance ntds'
  condition: (selection_image or selection_via_cmd) and selection_args and selection_ifm
falsepositives:
  - Sanctioned domain-controller backup / IFM media creation by AD ops (must come from documented host + service account)
level: high
tags:
  - attack.credential_access
  - attack.t1003.003
  - attack.t1059.003
ucs.datadog_query: (source:windows.sysmon @EventID:1 OR source:windows.security @EventID:4688) (@Image:(*\\ntdsutil.exe OR *\\NTDSUTIL.EXE OR *\\Ntdsutil.exe) OR @CommandLine:(*ntdsutil* OR *NTDSUTIL*)) @CommandLine:(*"create full"* AND (*ifm* OR *IFM* OR *"ac i ntds"* OR *"activate instance ntds"*))
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2 (ImageFileName=/\\ntdsutil\.exe$/i OR regex("ntdsutil", field=CommandLine, flags="i"))
| regex("create\\s+full", field=CommandLine, flags="i")
| regex("(\\sifm\\s|ac\\s+i\\s+ntds|activate\\s+instance\\s+ntds)", field=CommandLine, flags="i")
| StagingPath := regex("(?i)create\\s+full\\s+(?<sp>\\S+)", field=CommandLine, strict=false)
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, UserName, ParentBaseFileName, CommandLine, StagingPath], function=count())
ucs.rationale: CISA AA24-038A and AA23-144A both fingerprint the exact ntdsutil IFM 'create full' invocation against domain controllers as a Volt Typhoon (Vanguard Panda) signature, with documented staging to C:\Windows\Temp\Pro and C:\Users\Public. The combination of (1) ntdsutil binary or cmd-spawned ntdsutil token, (2) 'create full' subcommand, and (3) IFM / 'ac i ntds' modifier is essentially never seen outs
